concept: Review and integration: leadership as sustained service, accountability, and development of others
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across unpopular decisions, developing others, and public accountability — what's your personal throughline as a leader?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what leadership means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
